enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow under head. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Move arm under pillow. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Cup hands under water. Splash water on face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Wipe mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast while listening to the news
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Serve eggs onto plate. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pick up phone. Open news app. Listen to news. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet door. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet door. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in bag.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Greet partner. Say: 'Good morning.' Discuss program. Say: 'We need to finalize the schedule.' Take notes. Review calendar. Coordinate with colleagues. Print documents. File documents. Attend meeting. Present updates. Listen to feedback. Adjust plan. Save changes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lunch place. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning upcoming community events, updating schedules and reports
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open calendar. Plan event. Update schedule. Write report. Edit report. Save report. Send report. Make calls. Meet with team. Discuss event logistics. Create flyers. Print flyers. Distribute flyers. Check emails. Reply to emails. Organize files. Backup data. Shut down computer.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Wash pan. Rinse pan. Place pan in drying rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place utensils in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry hands. Wipe counter. Put away dishes. Take out trash.
Walk into living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check personal messages and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up computer. Open computer. Log in. Open messaging app. Read messages. Reply to messages. Open reading app. Read book. Close computer. Put computer on desk. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Turn off light. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to other side. Stretch. Move arm. Bend leg. Continue sleeping.
